articles.title: Monsoon Arrival in Kerala Delayed Again; Check Expected Onset Date; IMD Flags Below-Normal
articles.summary: The southwest monsoon, the lifeline of India's agriculture sector, has yet to make its official entry into Kerala despite earlier forecasts indicating an onset by late May. As meteorologists track its progress toward southern India, concerns are mounting over the broader monsoon outlook, with forecasts suggesting below-normal rainfall pointing to a strengthening El Nino that could influence weather patterns.

articles.title: Rare Apple-1 computer with letter from Steve Jobs, Steve Wozniak signature sells
articles.summary: An exceptionally rare, fully operational Apple-1 computer has sold at auction for $1. 15 million – setting a new world-record price for a commercially released model of the machine that started Apple. The sale concluded after an intense, 28-minute bidding battle between two collectors, with the PC crossing the auction block during Apple's 50th anniversary year.

articles.title: ED makes 6th arrest in pan-India digital arrest fraud case
articles.summary: The Enforcement Directorate has arrested Mukesh Kumar Pukhraj Jain in a significant money laundering investigation. The investigation revealed connections to 400 bank accounts and extensive transactions linked to other cases.

articles.title: Kapil Sibal criticises government over move to denotify Jantar Mantar
articles.summary: Kapil Sibal has criticised the government for denotifying Jantar Mantar as a designated protest site, claiming that the fundamental right to peaceful demonstration is currently under severe threat. He questioned the suitability of alternative locations like Ramlila Maidan and condemned official tactics against protesters, arguing that such measures ultimately undermine the democratic electoral system.

articles.title: Astha Kunj Park in Delhi Continues to Struggle with Crime

articles.title: Rahul Gandhi suggests political change in India amid growing protests

articles.title: Tripura: BSF hands over two detained Bangladeshi policemen to BGB
articles.summary: Two Bangladeshi police personnel inadvertently crossed into Indian territory while conducting an anti-narcotics operation. One officer chased a suspected drug trafficker and crossed the border, followed by his colleague.
